subQuestions.questionText: Choose a term/concept from COLUMN B that matches the statement in COLUMN A: 'The function of a rural settlement.' Write only Y or Z. (Y: multifunctional / Z: unifunctional)
subQuestions.memoText:
Correct answer: Z (unifunctional) (1 mark)
A rural settlement typically performs a single (unifunctional) function, e.g. farming, whereas an urban settlement is multifunctional.

subQuestions.questionText: Choose a term/concept from COLUMN B that matches the statement in COLUMN A: 'The site of a settlement.' Write only Y or Z. (Y: the exact land occupied by a settlement / Z: the location of a settlement in relation to its surroundings)
subQuestions.memoText:
Correct answer: Y (the exact land occupied by a settlement) (1 mark)
Site refers to the exact/actual land on which a settlement is built, while situation refers to the location of a settlement in relation to its surroundings.

options.Y: the exact land occupied by a settlement
options.Z: the location of a settlement in relation to its surroundings

subQuestions.questionText: Choose a term/concept from COLUMN B that matches the statement in COLUMN A: 'Purpose of land reform in South Africa.' Write only Y or Z. (Y: increases access to water / Z: decreases poverty)
subQuestions.memoText:
Correct answer: Z (decreases poverty) (1 mark)
A key purpose of land reform in South Africa is to decrease poverty by giving previously disadvantaged people access to land and the means to earn a living.

subQuestions.questionText: Choose a term/concept from COLUMN B that matches the statement in COLUMN A: 'Ensures communal land rights of farm workers.' Write only Y or Z. (Y: land tenure / Z: land redistribution)
subQuestions.memoText:
Correct answer: Y (land tenure) (1 mark)
Land tenure reform secures and ensures the communal land rights of farm workers and people living on the land.

subQuestions.questionText: Choose a term/concept from COLUMN B that matches the statement in COLUMN A: 'Government allocates land to previously disadvantaged people.' Write only Y or Z. (Y: land restitution / Z: land redistribution)
subQuestions.memoText:
Correct answer: Z (land redistribution) (1 mark)
Land redistribution is the programme through which the government allocates land to previously disadvantaged people, while land restitution returns land to those specifically dispossessed of it.

subQuestions.questionText: Choose a term/concept from COLUMN B that matches the statement in COLUMN A: 'Challenge associated with land reform.' Write only Y or Z. (Y: willing buyer/seller clause / Z: more commercial farmers)
subQuestions.memoText:
Correct answer: Y (willing buyer/seller clause) (1 mark)
The willing buyer/willing seller clause is a challenge associated with land reform, as sellers may demand high prices and the process becomes slow and expensive.

subQuestions.questionText: Choose a term/concept from COLUMN B that matches the statement in COLUMN A: 'The result of well-managed land reform.' Write only Y or Z. (Y: equal access to land / Z: unequal access to land)
subQuestions.memoText:
Correct answer: Y (equal access to land) (1 mark)
Well-managed land reform results in equal access to land for all people.

subQuestions.questionText: A central place town ...
subQuestions.memoText:
Correct answer: C (services the surrounding rural area) (1 mark)
A central place is a settlement that provides goods and services to the surrounding rural (hinterland) area.

subQuestions.questionText: A is classified as a low-order good compared to B because A ...
subQuestions.memoText:
Correct answer: B (has a lower price and is consumed regularly) (1 mark)
Low-order goods have a lower price and are purchased/consumed regularly (e.g. bread, milk), unlike high-order goods which are more expensive and bought less often.

options.A: is a luxury item and not needed daily.
options.B: has a lower price and is consumed regularly.
options.D: has a higher price and is purchased less often.

subQuestions.questionText: Range refers to the ... to buy a product.
subQuestions.memoText:
Correct answer: C (maximum distance travelled) (1 mark)
Range is the maximum distance a consumer is prepared to travel to buy a product or service.

subQuestions.questionText: The range of a high-order good is ...
subQuestions.memoText:
Correct answer: D (large due to its high cost) (1 mark)
High-order goods have a large range because their high cost means consumers are prepared to travel a greater distance to purchase them.

options.A: small due to its daily use.
options.B: large due to its daily use.
options.C: small due to its high cost.
options.D: large due to its high cost.

subQuestions.questionText: ... refers to the minimum number of customers needed to make a business profitable.
subQuestions.memoText:
Correct answer: B (Threshold population) (1 mark)
Threshold population is the minimum number of customers (people) needed to make a business/service profitable and viable.

subQuestions.questionText: The threshold population of a grocery store is ...
subQuestions.memoText:
Correct answer: B or D (both accepted) (1 mark)
B (high because it has more low-order goods) or D (low because it has more low-order goods). The official memo accepts BOTH B and D as correct.

options.A: low because it has more high-order goods.
options.B: high because it has more low-order goods.
options.C: high because it has more high-order goods.
options.D: low because it has more low-order goods.

subQuestions.questionText: The area from which a settlement draws its customers is its ...
subQuestions.memoText:
Correct answer: B (sphere of influence) (1 mark)
The sphere of influence is the area around a settlement from which it draws its customers/clients.

subQuestions.questionText: The sphere of influence of a city is greater than a village because it has a ... (i) population of 1 000. (ii) smaller radius. (iii) population of 100 000. (iv) larger radius.
subQuestions.memoText:
Correct answer: D ((iii) and (iv)) (1 mark)
A city has a greater sphere of influence than a village because it has a larger population (100 000) and a larger radius/reach.

subQuestions.memoText:
Expected answer: Geothermal gradient (1) (1 mark)
The geothermal gradient (increase in temperature with depth) is a physical factor affecting mining, while unskilled labour is a human factor.

subQuestions.questionText: Choose the correct word(s) from those given in brackets: Platinum is an example of a (renewable/non-renewable) resource.

Domestic trade is the exchange of goods within a country's own borders.
